summary: Abits Group Inc, a BVI-incorporated Hong Kong-based issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing two agreements with Shakawe Capital LLC: an October 30, 2026 Leak-Out Agreement capping the investor's sales of Commitment Shares at 10% of daily Nasdaq Capital Market volume (including pre- and after-hours), and a Standstill Waiver and Commitment Share True-Up Letter Agreement waiving the Section 6.13 post-effectiveness standstill to permit put notices and Put Share issuances under the September 14, 2026 Equity Purchase Agreement's $7,500,000 commitment fee. Board recommendation and advisors are not stated. The filing is a routine equity-line structural update, not a special situation. Watch dilution and resale overhang from True-Up Commitment Shares.
